title: Where the composer package is published
context: The GitHub repo is private. Public packagist.org only accepts public repositories, so it cannot read releases from this repo while it stays private.

options.label: Make the repo public and use packagist.org (pipeline tags and pings Packagist)
Keep it private and use Private Packagist (pipeline tags and pings it)
Keep it private; pipeline only tags, consumers install via a composer 'vcs' repository

rationale: Developer keeps the repo private and uses Private Packagist
